##
## Wavelet unit tests (GoogleTest)
##
## Builds:
## - `wavelet_gtest`: tests for wavelet traits, transforms, and result extraction.
##
add_executable(wavelet_gtest 
    wavelet_gtest.cpp
)

target_link_libraries(wavelet_gtest
    PRIVATE 
       google_test
       wavelet
       waveCoreLib
       linear_algebra
)

target_include_directories(wavelet_gtest 
    PRIVATE 
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src
)

include(GoogleTest)
nn_gtest_discover_tests(wavelet_gtest)

##
## pywt_parity_gtest: ground truth vs PyWavelets. Loads committed fixtures
## (fixtures/pywt_refs.npz, generated by scripts/testing/gen_pywt_refs.py)
## and compares per-subband L2 norms for regular + packet transforms.
##
add_executable(pywt_parity_gtest
    pywt_parity_gtest.cpp
)

target_link_libraries(pywt_parity_gtest
    PRIVATE
        google_test
        wavelet
        cnpy-static
        z
)

target_include_directories(pywt_parity_gtest
    PRIVATE
        ${cnpy_SOURCE_DIR}
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src
)

target_compile_definitions(pywt_parity_gtest
    PRIVATE
        TEST_FIXTURE_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fixtures"
)

set_target_properties(pywt_parity_gtest PROPERTIES CXX_CLANG_TIDY "")

nn_gtest_discover_tests(pywt_parity_gtest)
